mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN refund_rule rr ON rr.project_id = p.project_id

SELECT rr.refund_rule_id AS refundRuleId, rr.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.project_status AS projectStatus, rr.refund_type AS refundType, IFNULL(stage_stat.stage_count, 0) AS stageCount, stage_stat.min_fee_rate AS minFeeRate, stage_stat.max_fee_rate AS maxFeeRate, rr.create_time AS createTime, rr.update_time AS updateTime FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN refund_rule rr ON rr.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT refund_rule_id, COUNT(*) AS stage_count, MIN(fee_rate) AS min_fee_rate, MAX(fee_rate) AS max_fee_rate FROM refund_rule_stage GROUP BY refund_rule_id ) stage_stat ON stage_stat.refund_rule_id = rr.refund_rule_id
ORDER BY rr.update_time DESC, rr.refund_rule_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT rr.refund_rule_id AS refundRuleId, p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS projectTitle, p.project_status AS projectStatus, rr.refund_type AS refundType, rr.source_provider_id AS sourceProviderId, rr.provider_rule_id AS providerRuleId, rr.rule_description AS ruleDescription, rr.consumer_entry_enabled AS consumerEntryEnabled, rr.delivery_fee_refundable AS deliveryFeeRefundable, rr.create_time AS createTime, rr.update_time AS updateTime FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN refund_rule rr ON rr.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT stage_id AS stageId, refund_rule_id AS refundRuleId, min_before_start_minutes AS minBeforeStartMinutes, max_before_start_minutes AS maxBeforeStartMinutes, stage_result AS stageResult, fee_rate AS feeRate, fixed_fee_amount AS fixedFeeAmount, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM refund_rule_stage WHERE refund_rule_id = #{refundRuleId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, stage_id ASC
